technique: Unguarded refinery: 1-euro filter alone, no pre-filter sanitize/kinematic stage
when: pre-2026-06-02 baseline (the RED-FIRST condition measured before the guard was added)
outcome: 43/95 LEAKS incl. 6 hard crashes (DoS: `hand.landmarks.map is not a function`, null landmark reads); NaN/Inf/out-of-bounds coords, malformed confidence, hand-overflow and frame-time garbage all reached the DTO usable by the piano.
mechanism: The 1-euro filter attenuates single-frame velocity spikes below the human-velocity ceiling (so isolated teleports mostly don't leak), but it has no concept of structural validity, geometry, or garbage input -- it only smooths numeric noise, so anything that isn't noise (a crash-shaped payload, NaN, wrong array shape) passes straight through unchanged.
adopt_in_133: Do not repeat -- this is the documented cautionary baseline for why gen-133's input ABI must put a structural/kinematic guard stage BEFORE any smoothing stage, never smoothing alone as the only defense.
